prompt: A single small bell buoy floating on the open sea, seen from slightly above: a round float low in the water carrying a short open lattice frame with a bell hanging inside it, and on top a little raspberry pink #D9467A pennant flag on a thin mast. The buoy is drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading. From the buoy, concentric ripples spread far out across the water surface, drawn as fine engraved off-white lines in the water itself: wide flattened ellipses seen in perspective, much wider than tall, the nearer arcs larger and bolder, the farther arcs thinner and fading into the wave lines, with uneven rhythmic spacing, two or three rings close together, then a wide gap, then another tight group, then a wider gap. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the bottom to lighter cerulean at the top, bathymetric contour lines with small depth soundings drawn as tiny dots, subtle foam strokes and a few glints of light on the crests. Every wave is drawn as visible engraved line work, like a steel engraving, never painted, never smooth. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no gradient, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no horizon, no sky, no clouds, full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, the buoy small in the upper two thirds and towards the right, open calm water on the left and along the bottom. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of raspberry pink #D9467A on the pennant only.
